title: Scheduled irrigation zero/over-one-day rate fallback

equations: optional irrigation rate defaults to zero; the scheduled input rate is nonnegative and converted from mm/h to cm/day
if requested rate > 0 and depth/rate > 1 day, source rate is temporarily adapted to depth and event duration is one day
if requested rate <= 0, scheduled source rate is depth spread over one day
otherwise retain the requested rate and use depth/rate duration

scope: apply B1 zero-rate and over-one-day normalization to the existing typed scheduled DCS2 event
persist the normalized active-event source rate in the same candidate state used for interval retry
100000 deterministic events covering zero, too-low, equal-depth and faster rates
verify split request leaves candidate unpublished, partial/retry source rates agree, and interval offered amount reconstructs depth
non_goals: file parsing or optional-field decoding and external availability scaling
restart serialization, event calendar, accepted Richards flux, solute transport or production admission
multi-node scheduled SSDI distribution, full DCS1 path or intervals over the one-day source contract
pass_conditions: zero and too-low positive rates normalize to source rate=depth and one-day event duration
equal-depth and under-one-day requested rates are preserved
normalized event rate survives a partial interval and retry through the existing candidate state
100000 deterministic events pass at O0/O2 with identical transcripts and water-amount reconstruction
